body:
PR-2848 head 474642bac5 (normal push on b9ddc4b1d6).
(1) audit: added the 'aida mailbox migrate' COULD NOT VERIFY row (generator output; its unrelated fleet-row reshuffle left out).
(2) cli-1 budget: not this PR. bug_2201 contained_reviewer drives a fake-vendor reviewer launch: no mailbox send, no SessionStart hook, so the new gc never runs, and its registry is a tiny fixture. Same PR code measured 6.32s at c83f8ae7ab (run 39952174161) vs 10.33s at b9ddc4b1d6 (run 39956092951) after main merged. No budget entry added; if it recurs on main it needs its own spec.
(3) gc now stamps ended_at = last_active_at, never now; new test gc_ended_old_crash_does_not_outrank_a_recent_end_for_resume pins picker order, and the existing gc test asserts the value.
(4) mailbox_dir_guard uses fs::metadata (follows symlinks); tests: symlink to dir passes, symlink to manifest refuses.
LIGHT gate: targeted core 1 + cli-lib 28 passed; check-ci-fast 34 passed.
subject: READY: PR-2848 round 1 (STORY-1843)
